repairReviewed.authWait: 12-second reader-owned initial account wait. Timeout retires this reader attempt and exposes an honest error/Retry; it does not cancel or shorten Supabase's shared auth/token-refresh operation.
repairReviewed.requiredBookWait: 15-second reader-owned required book query budget, including SDK session acquisition and response-body parsing. Supported query transport receives an AbortSignal.
repairReviewed.mediaAuthorization: Existing media authorization retains separate 20-second stage bounds. No aggregate 15-second hydration cap and no publication before required authorization/hydration completes.
repairReviewed.cancellation: Local request ownership prevents deferred dispatch after retirement, consumes late success/rejection, clears owned timers, and retires results on route/account replacement, newer load, soundtrack confirmation and unmount.
repairReviewed.identity: An explicit auth-scope revision starts a replacement read after synchronous A-to-B-to-A callbacks even when React commits the original final user ID. Same-owner auth refresh does not restart or cancel the current required book query.
repairReviewed.recovery: Explicit Retry and newer authoritative auth events recover; obsolete initial read success/rejection cannot replace the newer state.
repairReviewed.preservedSave: saveSettings and openSettings callback text was independently compared with the before source and was byte-identical. Existing save acknowledgment, reload and committed-title behavior remained passing.

baselineObserved.controlledHeldWait: Actual-screen probe with controlled auth/book promises remained on a spinner without Retry after 120 seconds; releasing the required result exposed the reader. This was a source-level recoverability reproduction, not an iPhone runtime diagnosis.
baselineObserved.evidenceBasis: Retained tool result read the original before-tests.tap summary; Native's source-bound held-wait reproduction was independently read before the outage.

ownerStaticResults.attribution: Reported in the native owner's sealed pre-outage receipt; not independently rerun here.

conclusion: The exact frozen local repair was independently accepted before the outage, with 65/65 focused cases and unchanged input hashes. This reconstructed record preserves that observed outcome without representing a new test execution or exact recovery of the original evidence files.
